description: Add a Playwright end-to-end UI test suite for the frontend and use it to drive concrete UI/UX improvements. The suite must run headless against the built SPA using the offline seed fallback (no backend/AWS needed), capture screenshots as artifacts, and assert the bracket, standings, series cards, and prediction panel render and behave correctly. Findings from the Playwright run feed UI polish in the same feature.
steps: Add @playwright/test as a dev dependency in the frontend workspace. Install the chromium browser (npx playwright install --with-deps chromium, or at least chromium). Headless only; the sandbox has no display, so configure headless and chromium launch args --no-sandbox.

Create frontend/playwright.config.ts: testDir e.g. e2e/, use chromium headless with args ['--no-sandbox'], configure a webServer that runs `npm run preview` (vite preview) or `vite dev` on a fixed port and baseURL pointing at it, reuseExistingServer locally, screenshot on failure, output artifacts under a test-results/ dir (gitignored). Ensure the preview build is produced first (depend on `npm run build -w frontend`).

The prediction endpoint needs a backend that is not available in E2E. Handle this cleanly: either (a) use Playwright route interception (page.route) to stub GET/POST /prediction with a realistic Prediction JSON so the PredictionPanel success path can be asserted deterministically offline, and also add a test that stubs a 404/500 to assert the error state; and/or (b) assert the bracket/standings/series rendering which already works via the @mlb/shared seed fallback with no backend. Prefer route interception for prediction so both success and error UI states are covered end-to-end.

Write e2e specs under frontend/e2e/: (1) home.spec.ts - loads the app, asserts the brand/hero image assets are present (img/svg in DOM), the bracket renders all four rounds (Wild Card, Division Series, Championship Series, World Series) and AL/NL/WS lanes, and the 2024 World Series series card shows the Dodgers and Yankees with the correct 4-1 result; asserts the offline-fallback notice appears when no backend. (2) prediction.spec.ts - clicks a series's Predict affordance, with /prediction stubbed, asserts the favorite team, the win-probability indicator (percentage/progressbar), and the AI narrative render; a second case stubs an error and asserts the error/alert state. (3) capture full-page screenshots in each spec to the artifacts dir for visual inspection.

Run the Playwright suite headless and capture screenshots. Inspect the screenshots and the rendered accessibility tree for concrete UI problems (e.g. contrast, layout overflow, missing alt text on image assets, unreadable score badges, bracket lanes not visually connected, mobile/narrow-width breakage, missing loading affordance). Record the specific issues found.

Apply UI/UX improvements based on the Playwright findings to the React components and styles.css: ensure every image asset has meaningful alt text; ensure the bracket is visually legible (clear round headers, team badges with team colors and abbreviations, readable win/score, clear series status); ensure responsive layout does not overflow at narrow widths; ensure the prediction panel probability bar is clearly labeled and accessible (role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max and a visible percentage). Keep existing vitest unit tests green.

Add a frontend script `test:e2e` (playwright test) and wire it so it is runnable from the repo root (e.g. root script `test:e2e` -> `npm run test:e2e -w frontend`). Add Playwright output dirs (test-results/, playwright-report/, .playwright/) and the browser cache to .gitignore. Do NOT commit large browser binaries.

Re-run `npm run build -w frontend`, `npm test -w frontend` (vitest), and `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (Playwright) and confirm all pass. Commit the Playwright suite, config, and UI improvements with a clear message so progress is visible in git history.
acceptance_criteria: frontend has @playwright/test configured with a headless chromium project (--no-sandbox) and a webServer that serves the built SPA.

`npm run test:e2e -w frontend` runs the Playwright suite headless and passes, covering: app load + image assets present, full bracket (4 rounds, AL/NL/WS) rendering incl. the 2024 WS Dodgers vs Yankees 4-1 card, and the prediction flow success + error states (with /prediction route-stubbed).
Playwright captures screenshots to the artifacts/output directory for visual review.
Concrete UI/UX issues found via Playwright are fixed (alt text on image assets, legible bracket, accessible labeled probability bar, no narrow-width overflow); existing vitest unit tests still pass.
A root-level `test:e2e` script runs the suite; Playwright output dirs and browser binaries are gitignored (not committed).
verification: From repo root: `npm run build -w frontend` exits 0.
From repo root: `npm test -w frontend` (vitest) exits 0.
From repo root: `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (Playwright, headless chromium) exits 0 with all specs passing.
Confirm screenshots were written to the Playwright output / artifacts directory.
findings: FEAT-005 COMPLETE and VERIFIED. All three verification commands exit 0: `npm run build -w frontend`, `npm test -w frontend` (12 vitest tests), and `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (7 Playwright specs, headless chromium, --no-sandbox). == RUN COMMANDS == - E2E suite: `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` (root alias: `npm run test:e2e`). Both map to `playwright test` in frontend/playwright.config.ts. - Browser install (done once this session): `npx playwright install chromium` with env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/playwright (both full chromium-1232 and chromium-headless-shell present). The sandbox reports 'OS not officially supported' and downloads the ubuntu24.04-x64 fallback build; it works fine headless. - Launch args: headless:true + ['--no-sandbox','--disable-setuid-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage'] (nested sandboxing fails without --no-sandbox). - webServer: `npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 4318 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1`, baseURL http://127.0.0.1:4318, reuseExistingServer when not CI, 180s timeout. Playwright starts/stops the preview server itself. == SCREENSHOTS (artifacts) == Written to frontend/test-results/ (gitignored). Full-page captures: home-full.png, bracket-full.png, prediction-success.png, prediction-error.png, home-mobile.png (375px). Playwright also writes screenshot:'only-on-failure' + an HTML report to frontend/playwright-report/ (gitignored). NO browser binaries committed. == E2E COVERAGE (7 specs) == home.spec.ts: (1) app shell + brand/hero image assets present with meaningful alt, asserts ZERO imgs with missing/empty alt; (2) offline-fallback notice shown (no backend -> @mlb/shared 2024 seed); (3) all 4 rounds (Wild Card/Division Series/Championship Series/World Series) + AL/NL/WS legend lanes; (4) WS card [data-series-id=2024-ws-worldseries-119-147] shows 'Los Angeles Dodgers' + 'New York Yankees' and 4 / 1 meta; (5) narrow-width (375px) horizontal-overflow guard. prediction.spec.ts: (6) success via page.route stub of **/prediction* (favoriteTeamId:119, favoriteWinProbability:0.68, narrative, model) -> asserts favorite name, role=progressbar with aria-valuenow=68/min=0/max=100, visible '68.0%', narrative text; (7) 500 stub -> asserts role=alert 'Could not load prediction'. Shared stub helpers in e2e/fixtures.ts. == UI ISSUE FOUND + FIX == Concrete issue surfaced by Playwright: at 375px viewport the page had 36px of HORIZONTAL overflow because the bracket kept a two-column grid (the <=860px rule) that was wider than a phone screen (Division Series column clipped off-screen, confirmed in the failure screenshot). FIX (frontend/src/styles.css): added a <=560px media query collapsing .bracket__grid to a single column, stacking .app__header, making .app__hero full-width, and allowing long team names to wrap (overflow-wrap:anywhere; min-width:0). After the fix the e2e overflow guard passes (overflow 0) and home-mobile.png shows a clean single-column layout. Other acceptance items were already satisfied by FEAT-003 and verified (not merely assumed) via the suite + screenshot inspection: every /inline-SVG asset has meaningful alt/aria-label (brand logo, hero 'Baseball diamond at dusk', AL/NL/WS legend marks, TeamBadge role=img aria-label); bracket is legible with round headers, team-color badges + abbreviations, readable win totals, and FINAL/in-progress status pills; the prediction probability bar is an accessible, labeled role=progressbar (aria-valuenow/min/max + visible percentage). == CONFIG CHANGES == frontend/package.json: added @playwright/test devDep + `test:e2e` script. Root package.json: added `test:e2e` -> `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend`. frontend/vite.config.ts: scoped vitest to src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx} and excluded e2e/** (Playwright specs import @playwright/test's `test`, which otherwise breaks the vitest run). .gitignore: added test-results/, playwright-report/, .playwright/, playwright/.cache/ (and frontend/-prefixed variants). frontend/playwright.config.ts + frontend/e2e/{fixtures,home.spec,prediction.spec}.ts are new. == COMMITS (local only, not pushed) == 1. test(frontend): add Playwright e2e suite ... (config, specs, deps, gitignore, vitest scoping) 2. fix(frontend): prevent bracket horizontal overflow on narrow screens (the UI improvement driven by the e2e finding) == NOTE FOR FEAT-006 (ISSUES.md registry) == The single concrete, fixed issue to record: 'Bracket overflowed the viewport horizontally (~36px) at <=560px widths; fixed by collapsing to a single-column responsive layout.' Pre-existing uncommitted changes from other features remain in the working tree and were left untouched: .agents/tasks/.../task.json, infra/bin/app.ts, and the untracked review markdown + FEAT-006.json. I only staged my own FEAT-005 files.
